courses.title: Mathematics for Teachers
courses.prerequisiteText: Pre-Calculus 11 or Foundations of Mathematics 11 (or equivalent) with a grade of at least B, or Pre-Calculus 12 (or equivalent) with a grade of at least C, or SFU FAN X99 course with a grade of at least C.
courses.description: Designed for students pursuing a career as an elementary school teacher. Topics are drawn from number systems as well as plane, solid, and metric geometry. Examination of the historical and cultural development of mathematical ideas and their place in contemporary mathematics. Emphasis on deep understanding of mathematical concepts and on multiple representations: physical, pictorial, and symbolic. Detailed topics include: problem solving, bases, whole and fractional numbers and their arithmetic operations, number theory, ratios, rates, percent, polygons, polyhedra, symmetries, transformations, and measurements. This course may not be counted toward the mathematics minor, major or honours degree requirements. Intended to be particularly accessible to students who are not specializing in mathematics.
